svg.title: Thirty days from partner approval to verified Net EPC run-rate
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-commission-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty days from partner approval to verified Net EPC run-rate; subtitle: Four weekly underwriting, S2S build, BOFU launch & Kill/Fix/Scale phases; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end-days; full 3-12 month ramp applies to compounded organic/recurring cohorts.; caption: Validate conversion rate and Net EPC on bottom-of-funnel comparison intent in Month 1 before scaling content headcount.; stages: label: Underwrite & approve; value: Days 1-7; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Approve >=3 competing offers in 1 B2B/fintech vertical, audit clawback/TM+ terms, and map 25 BOFU queries.; label: Wire calculator & S2S; value: Days 8-14; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Ship <1s edge comparison calculator, FTC 255 bar, checklist capture, and synthetic S2S webhook test.; label: Launch guides & video; value: Days 15-21; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Publish 10 substantiated vs/pricing pages, 5 YouTube demos, and run a $300-$500 exact-match search test.; label: Reconcile & scale; value: Days 22-30; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Audit scrub reasons, negotiate a 20%-30% private CPA bump on early volume, and apply Kill/Fix/Scale rules.

circle.title: label: Underwrite & approve; value: Days 1-7; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Approve >=3 competing offers in 1 B2B/fintech vertical, audit clawback/TM+ terms, and map 25 BOFU queries.
label: Wire calculator & S2S; value: Days 8-14; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Ship <1s edge comparison calculator, FTC 255 bar, checklist capture, and synthetic S2S webhook test.
label: Launch guides & video; value: Days 15-21; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Publish 10 substantiated vs/pricing pages, 5 YouTube demos, and run a $300-$500 exact-match search test.
label: Reconcile & scale; value: Days 22-30; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Audit scrub reasons, negotiate a 20%-30% private CPA bump on early volume, and apply Kill/Fix/Scale rules.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone end-days; full 3-12 month ramp applies to compounded organic/recurring cohorts.
